sota_benchmark.source: MDPI Information 2026 — Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets

fleet_validation.S14_LR_discovery: S14 (Nomos42/nba-evo-5) GA at gen 845 independently discovered LogisticRegression as its best model. Brier improved 0.25312→0.22680 at just 22 features — without any explicit instruction to try LR. This is scientific validation that the SOTA direction (LR) is correct AND discoverable by pure evolution.
fleet_validation.implication: The GA, given enough generations, finds LR. We can accelerate this by explicitly seeding LR configs in all island inits rather than waiting for natural discovery.
fleet_validation.urgency: HIGH — S14 just proved it. Port to all islands.

key_papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
key_papers.key_finding: LR Brier 0.199, XGBoost 0.202 on walk-forward NBA test. LSTM with MC dropout provides calibrated uncertainty. Framework: team-level performance metrics + rolling-form indicators + spatial shot-chart embeddings.
key_papers.actionable_for_islands: Rolling-form indicators (5g/10g windows of W%, PTS_diff, ATS_cover_rate) are CPU-cheap and can be added to engine.py. Shot-chart embeddings require GPU but rolling form alone should yield -0.002 Brier.

key_papers.title: Stacked ensemble model for NBA game outcome prediction analysis
key_papers.key_finding: CNN achieves lowest Brier 0.221. Stacked ensemble (XGBoost + LR + RF base + LR meta) outperforms individuals. Key: diversity of base learners.
key_papers.actionable_for_islands: Our islands ban stacking (Rule #8, CPU-only). But LR as an independent engine option is valid. Adding LR to GA pool forces evolution to discover ensemble-equivalent diversity naturally.

key_papers.title: Integration of machine learning XGBoost and SHAP models for NBA game outcome prediction
key_papers.key_finding: Home advantage, team Elo ratings, and next-game rest are top 3 SHAP features across ALL models. Dominate over statistical features.
key_papers.actionable_for_islands: Add feature_always_include guard for home_advantage, elo_home, elo_away, days_rest_diff in GA init. 4-line change prevents GA from accidentally pruning these in feature selection.

proposals.title: Explicitly seed LogisticRegression configs in all NBA island GA inits
proposals.evidence: S14 discovered LR naturally at gen 845, achieving 0.22680 at 22f. SOTA LR achieves 0.199. Explicit seeding accelerates discovery on S13/S15/S18/S22.
proposals.implementation: In island GA init, add LogisticRegression(C=[0.01, 0.1, 1.0], solver='saga', max_iter=1000, penalty='l2') as seeded config. 5-10 individuals with LR configs in initial population. Feature count 20-35f (S14 shows 22f optimal).
proposals.feasibility: high — S14 proves LR is fast on CPU with 22f

proposals.title: Add rolling-form feature block to engine.py (5-game and 10-game windows)
proposals.evidence: SOTA uncertainty-aware framework uses rolling-form indicators as primary signal. Our features may have some rolling stats but not systematic 5g/10g windows.
proposals.implementation: Add to engine.py: rolling_5g_win_pct, rolling_10g_win_pct, rolling_5g_pts_diff, rolling_10g_pts_diff, rolling_5g_ats_cover, rolling_5g_efg_pct. All computable from existing boxscore data in nba_cached_data.npz. ~6 new features.
proposals.target: engine.py — applies to all islands after engine-parity-sync
proposals.feasibility: medium — requires engine.py edit (VM task, blocked by parity-sync)
proposals.blocker: engine-parity-sync must complete first (VM work-queue item pending)

proposals.title: Feature freeze for top-3 SHAP features in island GA
proposals.evidence: SHAP analysis across 3 independent papers: home_advantage, elo_delta, days_rest are top features consistently. GA may prune these during feature selection, losing core signal.
proposals.implementation: Add feature_always_include = ['home_advantage', 'elo_home', 'elo_away', 'days_rest_diff'] to island GA config. These bypass selection and are always passed to model. Reduces search space by 4 dimensions.

proposals.title: Port LR to political_engine.py GA pool
proposals.evidence: S14 proves LR works at 22f in NBA domain. Political GA currently uses xgboost_brier/lightgbm. Adding LR creates healthy engine diversity.
proposals.implementation: Add LogisticRegression to political island GA model pool. Target: P2 (fresh restart, most flexible) as first trial. P4/P5 near all-time best — don't disturb.

cross_domain_opportunity.nba_to_political: LR + rolling-form features map directly to political domain: 5-poll rolling average, recent event sentiment window, rolling-5-day approval change. Add to political_engine.py as rolling_N feature category.
cross_domain_opportunity.political_to_nba: P4 (lightgbm) and P5 (xgboost) competing at same brier with different engines — natural diversity preventing monoculture. Apply same multi-engine diversity to NBA: S13 (random_forest) + S14 (LR) + S15 (xgboost) is the right diversity pattern.

gap_closure_path.note: CPU-only fleet targeting 0.214 with proposed changes. Full SOTA 0.199 requires GPU (TabICL/LR+shot-chart) but 0.214 is achievable on HF CPU spaces.
